Application Materials.content:
Applicants must submit the following documents by the specified deadline:
- Academic/professional certificates: for all applicants, both graduation and professional qualification certificates. For degrees obtained from Chinese Mainland: both degree (學位證書) and graduation (畢業證書) certificates printed in Chinese, plus valid Online Verification Reports of Higher Education Qualification Certificates (教育部學歷證書電子註冊備案表) and Degree Certificates (中國高等教育學位在線驗證報告) issued from CHESICC for Mainland China degrees.
- Official transcripts and grading schemes: all copies of official transcripts and grading schemes with explanatory notes for all tertiary education. E-transcripts must be sent directly by the issuing university; paper transcripts must be in a sealed envelope issued by the university. Transcripts must bear official seal; unofficial or improper letterhead documents will not be accepted. Non-English/Chinese transcripts require certified English translation. CUHK graduates can submit photocopies of transcripts, excluding CUHK (Shenzhen); the University reserves the right to require an original copy.
- English language proficiency documents: submit one of the listed documents, such as a copy of graduation certificate issued by a university in Hong Kong; a certifying letter from the Registry confirming the medium of instruction was English; an official score report of TOEFL, IELTS (Academic), or GMAT (Verbal); specified Hong Kong examination results; certified true copy of GCE A-level or AS-level/CUHK Matriculation Examination English results; or certified true copy of a recognised professional qualification where the examination was in English.
- Confidential recommendations: for other programmes, **two referee reports are required**. Submit referee information via the [Online Application System](https://www.gradsch.cuhk.edu.hk/OnlineApp/login_email.aspx).
- Identification documents: Hong Kong Identity Card or other identity document.
- Qualification assessment: degrees awarded by overseas universities by distance learning or by completing a curriculum of short duration may be required to provide [HKCAAVQ](https://www.hkcaavq.edu.hk/en/) assessment on the level of qualification obtained.
- **Applicants will be required to complete an Authorisation Form for the University to verify their academic qualifications.** The programme staff may further contact applicants to proceed with applying for academic verification from a third-party organization, e.g. Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE), as needed.
Submitted documents are non-returnable; materials from unsuccessful applications will be destroyed after the completion of the admission exercise.

Interview Requirements.content: After submitting your application, you may be invited by email for an interview at the programme’s discretion.

Application Deadlines.content:
Admissions are on a rolling basis. We will reassess all applications until admissions close.
2026-27 Admission Application Deadline, Full-time:
- **1 Aug 2025 (Early Round)**
- **31 Mar 2026**
Application will be processed on a rolling basis until all places fill up. Therefore, early applications are strongly encouraged. The application deadline may be closed early if places are no longer available. The subsequent applications received may not be considered.

Academic Requirements.content:
- **A bachelor’s degree with Second Class honours or achieving an average grade of B from a recognized university, or an equivalent professional qualification.**
- The programme is designed for those with **a keen mind for numbers and statistics**.

GRE GMAT Requirements.content: GMAT / GRE scores are not mandatory, but a good GMAT / GRE score will strengthen the application.

English Proficiency Requirements.content:
To fulfil the University’s minimum English language requirements for admission to Master’s programmes, you should have:
- obtained a Degree from a university in Hong Kong* or taken a degree programme of which the medium of instruction was English; or
- achieved scores in any one of the following English Language tests** as indicated: **TOEFL: 79 of 120 / 4.5 of 6 (Internet-based/Home Edition); IELTS (Academic): 6.5 (Test Centre based / Online); GMAT: Band 21 (Verbal)#; GMAT Focus Edition: Band 78 (Verbal)**; or
- obtained a recognised professional## qualification, provided that the examination was conducted in English.
For more details, please go to the CUHK Graduate School website on the English Language Requirements for Admission [here](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/admissions/admissions/requirements).
Notes: *This is based on the understanding that English is the medium of instruction of degree programmes offered by universities in Hong Kong. Moreover, graduates from universities in Hong Kong should have fulfilled the English language requirements of the institution concerned when they were admitted to the degree programmes. The CUHK Graduate School may request applicants to provide additional supporting documents to prove their English proficiency. **TOEFL/IELTS result is valid for two years from the test date. GMAT / GMAT Focus Edition result is valid for five years from the test date. #GMAT (Verbal) Score with a threshold of 21 will be accepted until the score validity expires. ##The programmes/Graduate Divisions shall at their discretion to determine if such professional qualification can be accepted.
Applicant must provide the correct Appointment Number in our Admission Portal and request IELTS/ TOEFL to send the result as below: An official score report of TOEFL^ (share result with “0812 - The Chinese University of Hong Kong”), or IELTS (Academic)^ (share result with “The Chinese University of Hong Kong - Graduate School”) or GMAT (Verbal)^. ^TOEFL and IELTS scores are considered valid for two years from the test date. GMAT scores are considered valid for five years from the test date.

Program Overview.content:
The MSc in Business Analytics is an advanced one-year programme designed to train professionals to analyse data with quantitative tools and convert it into useful information. Students are equipped to guide strategic decision making for organisations all over the world.
Students are trained in statistical tools and quantitative methods to explore and investigate mass data. Under the guidance of professionals, they learn to make extensive use of data, identify key insights about performance, predict market changes and improve strategic decisions.
**Duration:** Full-time: 1 year. **Programme commencement:** September.
Students study in Hong Kong, a global centre of finance and logistics, with geographical proximity to China. CUHK Business School was the first to offer an MSc in Business Analytics in Hong Kong, giving students access to experienced professionals with in-depth knowledge of the market and state-of-the-art facilities.
The advanced curriculum is highly flexible, with a wide range of electives so students can tailor their studies to their interests. By the end of the programme, graduates are prepared for careers in business consulting, finance, marketing, retail, logistics and supply chain management, and other service industries.
The programme was set up in response to the growing demand for data-driven decision making, with the aim of filling a significant skills gap in the industry. It is designed for those with a keen mind for numbers and statistics.
**1st** MSc in Business Analytics programme in Greater China.
An alumna describes the programme as taught by “internationally renowned professors” using teaching methods such as group projects, case studies, simulations, guest speakers and real-life examples, providing in-depth market insights, critical thinking development, and exposure to Asian business culture.

Curriculum.content:
The MSc in Business Analytics is a full-time, **1-year** programme commencing in September. To complete the programme, students need to attain **30 credits of coursework**, comprising **5 core courses and 5 elective courses worth 3 credits each**.
Programme schedule notes: Core and elective courses are subject to change. Courses are taught in English, except when Chinese is preferable. Elective courses may be offered in the form of an intensive course every alternate year or in the summer term.
Full-time Programme (1 Year):
- Term 1 Sep-Nov: 3 core courses; 1-2 elective courses
- Term 2 Dec-Mar: 1 core course; 1-2 elective courses
- Term 3 Mar-Jun: 1 core course; 1-2 elective courses
Core courses:
- [Statistical Analysis](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-0)
- [Decision Models and Applications](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-1)
- [Data Mining for Managers](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-2)
- [Machine Learning for Business I](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-3)
- [Advanced Business Analytics Practicum](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-curriculum-1-4): requires students to complete a real-world information systems project, in collaboration with a company or an organisation, in a project team under the joint supervision of a teacher and an executive of the sponsoring company.
Elective courses include:
- Managing Service Operations
- Economic Analytics
- Web Analytics and Intelligence
- Business Process Analysis and Simulation
- Database and Big Data Management
- Supply Chain and Logistics Management
- Technology Field Study
- Machine Learning for Business II
- Fintech and Its Applications
- Business Field Study
- Risk and Operations Analytics
- Generative Artificial Intelligence for Business
- Selected Topics of Information and Technology Management: Building AI for Business
- Selected Topics in Business Analytics: Marketing Intelligence
Other elective courses: Students may take up to **6-credits-worth** of courses from other programmes within CUHK Business School or from the Faculty of Engineering, subject to approval by Programme Directors. Courses may include Customer Relationship Management, Mergers and Acquisitions, Financial Analysis and Security Trading, and Organisational Marketing.
Course exemption: Students may be exempt from taking a course if they have completed an equivalent course in postgraduate studies and achieved a grade B or above. Students may be exempt from a maximum of **6 credits**, subject to approval, and need to substitute these exempt credits with other elective courses.
Graduation requirements: To graduate, students must complete the prescribed coursework and achieve a cumulative grade-point average (GPA) of at least **2.50**. Students who receive a grade D+ or below in a course must repeat the course or take an approved substitute course.
Overseas field trip elective courses include:
- [Technology Field Study (Elective Course)](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-eal-6a517ba0813a6): preparatory assignments in readings and a written study plan, followed by a five-day residential programme to Silicon Valley, California or similar Science Parks in Asia, concluded with a written report and an oral presentation.
- [Business Field Study (Elective Course)](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/programmes/mscba/?tab=curriculum#collapse-eal-6a517ba08140c): preparatory assignments in readings and a written study plan, followed by a five to seven-day residential programme in a selected country or economy outside of Hong Kong, concluded with a written report and oral presentation.
Non-local students, subject to endorsement from the Programme Director, may take curriculum-related internships for up to **one-third of the duration of the programme**.
The programme offers highly flexible personalised pathways for specialisations in fintech, digital marketing, business intelligence and supply chain analytics.

Cost of Attendance.content:
Cost of Living: CUHK has eight faculties and over 9,000 hostel places for our students. Here is an estimate of the overall living costs when studying at CUHK.
- On-Campus Accommodation: about HK$17,000
- Living Expenses: about HK$45,000
For information about off-campus accommodation, please visit: [https://lces.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/non-local-students-support/on-and-off-campus-accommodation/](https://lces.osa.cuhk.edu.hk/non-local-students-support/on-and-off-campus-accommodation/)

Financial Aid.content:
Several financial aid options are available to both local and non-local students.
- [Continuing Education Fund (CEF)](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/tuitionfee-financialaid-scholarships/#collapse-ad37c87-0): Some of the courses in our master’s programmes are considered reimbursable for [CEF](https://www.wfsfaa.gov.hk/en/ce/cef/overview.php) purposes. Eligible candidate could reimburse up to **HK$20,000** once successfully completed the course. For details, please check with programme office.
- A wide range of scholarships is offered by CUHK Business School and specific Master’s programmes to outstanding candidates. These scholarships encompass both admission-based and merit-based awards.
- [Admission Scholarships](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/tuitionfee-financialaid-scholarships/#collapse-3510f69a-0): All applications will be automatically considered for the scholarship and no separate application is needed. The Programmes will identify qualified students and inform the selected students of the scholarship offers.
- **BOC-CUHK International Scholarship** is designed to support outstanding students from ASEAN countries who wish to further pursue their postgraduate studies at CUHK Business School. To be eligible, applicants must be admitted into one of the listed CUHK Business School Master’s Programmes, including **MSc in Business Analytics**. Scholars will be entitled to 60% coverage of tuition fees, work on a practicum project sponsored by BOCHK during the study period, and fast-track interview opportunities to work for BOC offices in HK or SEA upon graduation.
- **BTS Group Scholarship** aims to support students from Thailand to pursue their graduate degree in business at CUHK Business School. Scholars will be awarded **HK$120,000 in tuition**, in addition to a living expenses of **HK$30,000**.
- **Scholarship for Malaysian students**: Support outstanding students who are Malaysian citizen to pursue Master’s studies at CUHK Business School. Scholars will be awarded up to **HK$320,000 in tuition**.
- Different scholarship schemes will be awarded to exceptional candidates based on the decision of each Master’s programme below: **MSc in Business Analytics**.
- [Merit-based Scholarships](https://masters.bschool.cuhk.edu.hk/tuitionfee-financialaid-scholarships/#collapse-3510f69a-2): Students who consistently excel in academic performance and professional development are eligible to receive the award for their outstanding achievements. There is no need to submit a separate application for the majority of our merit-based scholarships; some scholarships schemes may require application.
- **Additional Opportunities**: MSc in Business Analytics also provide different varieties of merit-based scholarship scheme to outstanding student during Master’s study. Respective programme will evaluate eligible students and communicate scholarship offers directly to the selected individuals.

Multiple Applications.content: You can apply for multiple programmes, but you must submit separate applications and pay the application fees for each programme. The paid application fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. If admitted to multiple programmes, you can only enrol in one. All fees paid to the previous programmes will not be refunded or transferred.

Deferral Admission Policy.content:
Successful applicants are normally admitted to the following Fall Term (beginning in August). Applications for deferred admission to the Spring Term (beginning in January) or the next academic year will only be considered if students are unable to take up the study due to illness or an unavoidable cause. The **maximum period for deferred admission is one year**. Applications for deferred admission should be made to the Graduate Division Head before the start of the academic year.
An applicant who has been offered admission but wishes to defer registration, i.e., deferred admission, should submit an application before the start of the academic year to the Head of the Graduate Division for approval.

Conditional Admission Policy.content:
Final-year undergraduates can apply for postgraduate programmes admission. Applicants should submit their latest official transcript; if accepted, they must provide an official final transcript and degree certificate upon admission.
Applicants who receive an admission offer with condition(s) should follow the steps in [How to Register](https://www.gs.cuhk.edu.hk/registration/how-to-register) for provisional registration. Student status is not yet confirmed and students will **NOT be allowed to begin studies until all specified condition(s) are fulfilled and academic qualification is verified by the deadline mentioned in the Admission Notification**.
If applicants cannot provide document(s) to fulfil the admission condition(s) mentioned in the Admission Notification, **the admission offer will be withdrawn**. Applicants are also required to have academic qualifications verified before the admission date.
